chunks: The expiations for gatherings are that you say, when rising from them:
'Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace be upon the messengers. And all praise is due to Allah, Lord of the worlds.'

key_terms.الْمَجَالِسِ: gatherings or sittings in which people assemble
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ: glorification of Allah and declaration of His transcendence
key_terms.كَفَّارَاتُ: acts of expiation that erase or make amends for shortcomings

ai.seo_question: What should be recited as the expiation for gatherings when leaving a gathering?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that one of the expiations for what may occur in gatherings is to conclude them with these Quranic words of glorification, peace, and praise. The supplication combines declaring Allah’s transcendence, sending peace upon the messengers, and ending with praise of Allah, Lord of the worlds.
